== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Star Trek CCG finalist, Vincent Van Wageningen of the Netherlands." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
